stageNotes: Stage 1: input host outfitters.goldnloan.com returned 200 OK directly; <link rel=canonical href='https://outfitters.goldnloan.com/'> confirms canonical = host. No www-fallback needed.

Stage 2: 8/8 batches clean. cf-ray on every request but consistent timing, no 4xx/5xx, no challenge body. Honeypot 404 = app default (76KB layout body, not WAF block). hasWaf=false (operational); cloudflare-passive recorded informationally. No CAPTCHA markers (recaptcha/hcaptcha/turnstile) anywhere in homepage HTML.

Stage 3: <meta name='generator' content='Odoo'/> + dr_theme_config JSON + load_more_products config + tp-* CSS classes (theme prefix) confirm odoo. adapterType=generic-retail per skill mapping. No age-gate (no DOB form, no 'I am 18 or older' button, no age_verified cookie). needsPlaywright=false because plain HTTP GET returns full product listing markup with schema.org cards.

Stage 4: discovered 12 candidate top-level Odoo categories from homepage nav + /shop sidebar (single-word-slug pattern + numeric ID); walked each at ?ppg=2000. Productive (>=58): accessories, ammunition, archery, firearms, fishing, hunting, optics, reloading-supplies, clothing. Empty/non-product: air-rifle-171, second-173, shipping-160. Per Rule C scope: included accessories/ammunition/archery/firearms/hunting/optics/reloading-supplies/air-rifle; excluded fishing-92 (pure fishing) and clothing-91 (pure apparel). 18-product residual gap (in /shop ?ppg=2000 but not in any included cat) traced to uncategorized hoodies = clothing -> out of scope. catalogUrls covers 100% of firearm-relevant products.

Stage 5: probed Odoo pagination: /shop/page/2 returns 200 (910KB) and product link cards with /shop/<slug>-<id>?page=2 -- page 2 product IDs [194, 192, 191, 190, 188] disjoint from page 1 [218, 217, 215, 214, 213]. perPage probe: default 20, ppg=80 returned 80 unique products clean, ppg=2000 / ppg=10000 both returned 1880 unique (the actual catalog ceiling, not a server cap). Set perPage=80 as conservative-fast value.

Stage 6: <input type='hidden' name='order' value=''/> on /shop with sort links exposing 5 options: create_date+desc, list_price+asc, list_price+desc, name+asc, website_sequence+asc. 3-outcome counter-control: default first 5 ids=[218,217,215,214,213] (website_sequence manual order). ?order=create_date+desc first 5 ids=[4868,4867,4866,4865,4864] (descending). ?order=name+asc starts with leading-space ISOtunes (alpha). All three sets differ -- sort honored. sortParam='?order=create_date+desc', sortVerified=true.

Stage 7: navigate-from-watermark -- listing exposes monotonic numeric id at end of every product slug; sortParam puts highest id first; combined gives watermark crawler a clean newest-first signal. No Odoo storefront API for unauthenticated date-filtered fetch (rules out api-date-since-watermark); full-catalog-sweep not needed.

Stage 8: no API count endpoint on storefront for unauth users; sitemap product entries=2018 (includes some archived /shop URLs); /shop?ppg=2000 returns 1880 distinct product cards. ppg=10000 same 1880 -- confirms not a server cap. expectedProductCount=1880 with productCountMethod={method:'html-pagination', selector:'ppg=2000 dump count', perPage:1}.
Stage 9: validator-ready. All 9 required + 7 recommended fields present.
